name: Lexford Law
tagline: Clear counsel for the moments that matter.
response_note: We return every call and email within one business day.
confidentiality_note: What you tell us in a consultation stays between us, whether or not you hire the firm.
disclaimer: Attorney advertising. The information on this website is not legal advice, and contacting the firm does not create an attorney–client relationship. Prior results do not guarantee a similar outcome.

values.name: Clarity
values.description: Plain answers, in writing, before any work begins. You will always know where your matter stands and what it will cost.

values.name: Discretion
values.description: Your affairs are handled by the few people who need to know them — and never discussed anywhere else.

values.name: Resolve
values.description: We prepare every matter as if it will go to court. That is usually why it doesn’t have to.

approach_steps.title: A first conversation
approach_steps.body: Thirty minutes, by phone or in person. You tell us what happened; we tell you honestly whether we can help.

approach_steps.title: A written plan
approach_steps.body: Within a week you receive a short letter setting out your options, our recommended course, and a fixed or capped fee.

approach_steps.title: One attorney, start to finish
approach_steps.body: The partner you meet is the partner who does the work — and who answers when you call.

art_direction.identity: A quiet, established law firm: ivory canvas, green-black ink, generous whitespace, warm editorial photography with softly rounded corners, forest-green panels for the hero and the closing consultation band, and pill-shaped buttons.
art_direction.type: Newsreader for every heading, attorney name and the giant wordmark (regular weight, tight tracking); Inter for body and interface text at 1rem with a relaxed line height.
art_direction.color: Ivory canvas and paper surface, ink text in two tiers (ink, muted), hairline lines. One accent: primary (forest green) only for the main button, the hero panel, the consultation band and link hovers. Text on primary uses primary-foreground. Never add a second accent.
art_direction.signature: The wordmark — the firm's short name (site.wordmark) set enormous in Newsreader, rising out of the bottom of the full-width team photograph in the canvas color. Keep it on the homepage wherever the design evolves.
art_direction.voice: Measured, plain-spoken and reassuring. Short sentences, no legalese, no superlatives, no promises about outcomes, no exclamation points.
